instruction: Candid street photograph, medium full shot. On a city sidewalk during the day, the woman in the white halter maxi dress (R2) on the left and the person in the light blue denim jacket (R1) on the right run forward side-by-side. Both are smiling joyfully and looking ahead, with the woman's (R2) hair blowing in the wind. They hold hands in the center as they run. The background features blurred city elements and trees. Soft, natural daylight highlights their happy expressions and the vibrant pride face paint on their cheeks.
